entries.english: A pending journal copy stops if you switch workspaces before it can download.
entries.st: Kopi e ntseng e emetse ea jenale e ea emisa haeba u chencha libaka tsa ts'ebetso pele e ka khoasolla.
entries.ts: Kopi leyi yimelaka ya jenali ya nsimu ya yima loko u cinca tindhawu ta mintirho yi nga si dowlodiwa.
entries.ve: Khophi i re kha u lindela ya dzhenala i a ima arali na shandukisa fhethu ha u shumela i sa athu kopololwa.
entries.zu: Ikhophi yencwadi yensimu esalindile iyama uma ushintsha izindawo zokusebenza ngaphambi kokuthi idawunilodeke.

entries.english: Write a dated field note from a checked crop task in your device journal.
entries.st: Ngola ntlha ea tšimo e nang le letsatsi ho tsoa mosebetsing o hlahlobiloeng oa lijalo jenaleng ea sesebelisoa sa hau.
entries.ts: Tsala notsi xa le masinwini lexi nga na siku ku suka eka ntirho lowu kamberiweke wa swibyariwa eka jenali ya xitirhisiwa xa wena.
entries.ve: Nwalani notsi ya tsimuni i re na ḓuvha u bva kha mushumo wo sedzwaho wa tshimela kha dzhenala ya tshishumiswa tshanu.
entries.zu: Bhala inothi yasensimini enosuku kusuka kumsebenzi wesitshalo ohloliwe ejenalini yasensimini yedivayisi yakho.

entries.english: Review older device notes before choosing which entries to recover.
entries.st: Hlahloba lintlha tsa khale tsa sesebelisoa pele u khetha hore na ke lintlha life tseo u lokelang ho li khutlisa.
entries.ts: Hlola tinotsi swa khale swa xitirhisiwa u nga si hlawula leswaku hi tihi tinotsi leti nga ta tlhela ti vuyisiwa.
entries.ve: Tolani notsi dza kale dza tshishumiswa ni sa athu nanga zwine na tama u zwi vhuedzedza.
entries.zu: Buyekeza amanothi amadala edivayisi ngaphambi kokukhetha ukuthi yikuphi okufanele ukubuyise.

entries.english: Preview saved monthly production with actual records and estimates labelled.
entries.st: Bona esale pele tlhahiso e bolokiloeng ea khoeli le khoeli e nang le lirekoto tsa sebele le likhakanyo tse ngotsoeng mabitso.
entries.ts: Vona ku sungula vuhumelerisi bya n'weti na n'weti lebyi hlayisiweke lebyi nga na tirhekhodo ta xiviri na swiringanyeto leswi vekiweke marito.
entries.ve: Vhonani tsedzuluso ya mbuelo yo vhulungwaho ya nwedzi na nwedzi i re na rekhodi dza vhukuma na dzo anganyelwaho dzo bulwaho.
entries.zu: Bona kusengaphambili umkhiqizo wenyanga ogciniwe onamarekhodi angempela kanye nezilinganiso ezibhalwe ngokucacile.

entries.st: Hlahloba jenale ea hau ea tšimo
entries.ts: Hlola jenali ya wena ya nsimu

entries.english: Open your device journal to write a note or review older copies when the app offers recovery.
entries.st: Bula jenale ea sesebelisoa sa hau ho ngola ntlha kapa ho hlahloba likopi tsa khale ha lenaneo le fana ka monyetla oa ho li khutlisa.
entries.ts: Pfula jenali ya xitirhisiwa xa wena ku tsala notsi kumbe ku hlola tikopi ta khale loko tirhiso ri nyika ndlela yo vuyisa.
entries.ve: Vulani dzhenala ya tshishumiswa tshanu u itela u nwala notsi kana u tola khophi dza kale musi phurogireme i tshi khou vhuedzedza.
entries.zu: Vula ijenali yasensimini yedivayisi yakho ukuze ubhale inothi noma ubuyekeze amakhophi amadala lapho uhlelo lokusebenza luhlinzeka ngokubuyisela.

entries.st: Bona esale pele tlhahiso e bolokiloeng ea khoeli le khoeli
entries.ts: Vona ku sungula vuhumelerisi bya n'weti na n'weti lebyi hlayisiweke
entries.ve: Vhonani tsedzuluso ya mbuelo yo vhulungwaho ya nwedzi na nwedzi

entries.english: Production plan → Production and food stock records
entries.st: Polane ea tlhahiso → Lirekoto tsa tlhahiso le tsa setoko sa lijo
entries.ts: Pulani ya vuhumelerisi → Tirhekhodo ta vuhumelerisi na switoko swa swakudya
entries.ve: Pulane ya mbuelo → Rekhodi dza mbuelo na zwiliwa zwo vhulungwaho
entries.zu: Uhlelo lokukhiqiza → Amarekhodi omkhiqizo nawesitoko sokudla

entries.english: Open a checked mapped site and preview its saved monthly records. Actual records and estimates stay separate.
entries.st: Bula sebaka se 'mapiloeng se hlahlobiloeng 'me u bone esale pele lirekoto tsa sona tse bolokiloeng tsa khoeli le khoeli. Lirekoto tsa sebele le likhakanyo li lula li arohane.
entries.ts: Pfula ndhawu leyi kamberiweke ya mepe u vona ku sungula tirhekhodo ta yona ta n'weti na n'weti leti hlayisiweke. Tirhekhodo ta xiviri na swiringanyeto swi tshama swi hambanile.
entries.ve: Vulani fhethu ho sedzwaho ha maepu ni vhone tsedzuluso ya rekhodi dzo vhulungwaho dza nwedzi na nwedzi. Rekhodi dza vhukuma na dzine dza khou anganyelwa zwi dzula zwo fhambana.
entries.zu: Vula isiza esidwetshiwe esihloliwe bese ubona kusengaphambili amarekhodi aso anyanga zonke agciniwe. Amarekhodi angempela nezilinganiso kuhlala kwehlukene.
